comment: Params 50 to 65 are the sixteen additive harmonic levels, edited in the display when the additive shape is chosen; they carry no panel position of their own. The menu item reads Retrigger With Phase=0 while the parameter the maker configured for it is named Random Phase on Retrigger; the item name is the one printed on screen and is what the line uses. The retrigger input is read twice over: a rising edge through 1V restarts the oscillator, and its level is also read as a gate that is high above 2V.
